intelligence.enrichment: Harmful substances such as tobacco, gutka, cigarettes, beedi, alcohol, and illegal drugs can damage physical and mental health and are addictive. A person should say no to addictive substances the first time and every time, and seek help from trusted people, counselling, or medical advice when needed. first or repeated substance use -> addiction risk and health problems; refusal and support -> protection and recovery help The learner applies the rule that tobacco, gutka, cigarettes, beedi, alcohol, and illegal drugs should be refused from the first offer because they are harmful and addictive, and help should be sought when needed. Trying a harmful substance once is a normal adolescent experiment and can always be stopped easily.
